title: Require Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Ensure that multi-factor authentication is enabled for all users to enhance security and comply with GDPR.
remediation: Enable MFA in Azure AD portal under Security → Authentication methods

title: Manage User Consent
description: Ensure that user consent is managed and recorded in compliance with GDPR requirements.
remediation: Implement consent management in Azure AD and ensure records are kept for all user consent.

title: Ensure Right to Access
description: Ensure that data subjects have the right to access their personal data as per GDPR.
remediation: Configure Azure AD to allow data subjects to access their personal data.

title: Ensure Data Portability
description: Ensure that data subjects can receive their personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.
remediation: Enable data portability features in Azure AD to allow data export.

title: Ensure Right to Erasure
description: Ensure that data subjects have the right to erasure of their personal data.
remediation: Configure Azure AD to allow for the erasure of personal data upon user request.

title: Implement Privacy by Design
description: Ensure that privacy settings are integrated by default in all processing activities.
remediation: Review and integrate privacy settings by default in Azure AD configurations.

title: Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments
description: Ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is conducted for high-risk processing.
remediation: Perform and document Data Protection Impact Assessments for high-risk data processing activities.

title: Ensure Breach Notification
description: Ensure that procedures are in place to notify supervisory authorities of data breaches within 72 hours.
remediation: Set up alerts and procedures in Azure AD to detect and report data breaches promptly.

title: Ensure Data Minimization
description: Ensure that only data necessary for each specific purpose of processing is collected and processed.
remediation: Review and limit data collection and processing to what is necessary for the intended purpose.

title: Ensure Accountability
description: Ensure that measures are in place to demonstrate compliance with GDPR principles.
remediation: Implement and document technical and organizational measures to ensure and demonstrate compliance.

title: Designate Data Protection Officer
description: Designate a Data Protection Officer if required by GDPR.
remediation: Designate a Data Protection Officer if processing activities require regular and systematic monitoring of data subjects on a large scale.

title: Maintain Records of Processing Activities
description: Ensure that records of processing activities are maintained as required by GDPR.
remediation: Maintain and update records of processing activities under the responsibility of the controller.

title: Ensure Security of Processing
description: Ensure appropriate security measures are in place to protect personal data.
remediation: Implement technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk.

title: Ensure Data Subject Rights
description: Ensure that data subjects can exercise their rights under GDPR.
remediation: Implement procedures to facilitate data subjects' rights, including access, rectification, erasure, and portability.

title: Implement Data Protection by Design
description: Ensure that data protection principles are integrated into processing activities by design.
remediation: Integrate data protection principles into the design of processing activities and systems.

title: Ensure Data Processing Agreements
description: Ensure that agreements with data processors comply with GDPR requirements.
remediation: Review and update agreements with data processors to ensure compliance with GDPR.

title: Ensure Safeguards for Data Transfers
description: Ensure that appropriate safeguards are in place for transferring personal data outside the EU.
remediation: Implement safeguards such as standard contractual clauses or binding corporate rules for data transfers.

title: Provide Data Protection Training
description: Ensure that staff involved in data processing activities are trained in data protection.
remediation: Provide regular training and awareness programs on data protection and GDPR compliance.

title: Conduct Data Protection Audits
description: Ensure that regular audits are conducted to verify compliance with data protection policies.
remediation: Conduct regular audits and assessments to ensure ongoing compliance with data protection policies.

title: Ensure Independence of Data Protection Officer
description: Ensure that the Data Protection Officer operates independently and without conflict of interest.
remediation: Ensure the Data Protection Officer can perform tasks independently and report to the highest management level.

title: Provide Resources for Data Protection Officer
description: Ensure that the Data Protection Officer has the necessary resources to carry out tasks.
remediation: Provide the Data Protection Officer with necessary resources, access to data, and support for training.

title: Define Tasks for Data Protection Officer
description: Ensure that the tasks of the Data Protection Officer are clearly defined and communicated.
remediation: Clearly define and communicate the tasks of the Data Protection Officer, including monitoring compliance and advising on data protection impact assessments.

title: Provide Contact Details of Data Protection Officer
description: Ensure that the contact details of the Data Protection Officer are published and communicated to data subjects.
remediation: Publish and communicate the contact details of the Data Protection Officer to data subjects and supervisory authorities.

title: Ensure Reporting Structure for Data Protection Officer
description: Ensure that the Data Protection Officer reports directly to the highest management level.
remediation: Ensure the Data Protection Officer reports to the highest management level and is not penalized for performing tasks.

title: Prevent Conflict of Interest for Data Protection Officer
description: Ensure that the Data Protection Officer does not have tasks that result in a conflict of interest.
remediation: Ensure that any additional tasks of the Data Protection Officer do not result in a conflict of interest.

title: Ensure Secrecy for Data Protection Officer
description: Ensure that the Data Protection Officer is bound by secrecy or confidentiality concerning the performance of tasks.
remediation: Ensure the Data Protection Officer is bound by secrecy or confidentiality in accordance with Union or Member State law.

title: Ensure Access for Data Protection Officer
description: Ensure that the Data Protection Officer has access to personal data and processing operations.
remediation: Provide the Data Protection Officer with access to personal data and processing operations necessary to carry out tasks.

title: Ensure Cooperation with Supervisory Authority
description: Ensure that the Data Protection Officer cooperates with the supervisory authority.
remediation: Ensure the Data Protection Officer cooperates with the supervisory authority and acts as a contact point.

title: Ensure Competence of Data Protection Officer
description: Ensure that the Data Protection Officer has expert knowledge of data protection law and practices.
remediation: Ensure the Data Protection Officer maintains expert knowledge of data protection law and practices through regular training.

title: Ensure Early Involvement of Data Protection Officer
description: Ensure that the Data Protection Officer is properly and in a timely manner involved in all issues relating to data protection.
remediation: Involve the Data Protection Officer in all issues relating to data protection from the earliest possible stage.
